title: when the Orca inbox fails graph --json prints the nodes and the recorded links with a notice, names the failed call without Orca's text and exits 3
source: intended: docs/decisions.md, release 2 of the communication plan
intent: The inbox is the one call whose answer holds message content, so its failure line carries the error code alone, never the message or the output of Orca.

stdout.contains:
"orca": true,
  "notices": [
    "Orca messages could not be read: only the synapses recorded with jitso link are shown."
  ],
